_comment: Controls when the tracker STOPS auto-updating and ARCHIVES each state's 2026 general data. Certification is not machine-readable, so a state freezes once BOTH conditions hold: (a) the calendar has passed its `certified_after` date, AND (b) its live data has been unchanged for `stale_days` (the source stopped moving = counting/canvass done). This staleness gate makes the exact dates non-critical: set them a little early and the freeze still waits until the numbers are actually final. At `hard_stop` any state still live is frozen regardless, so the whole system halts even if a feed misbehaves. Dates are best-effort statewide certification dates for the 2026 general election (Election Day 2026-11-03) and can be edited freely.
